Ms. Rimo (pronounced "Lmao") was soon buried under her collection of Nazi memorabilia, her left arm being perforated by several SS Bayonets.

After the earthquake, she was rescued by a group of very confused rescue workers and brought to hospital. Doctors were successfully able to save her left arm, however during the surgery her gown slipped revealing a tattoo on her right arm celebrating the rape of Nanking. The tattoo was mistaken for a malignant growth and her surgeons amputated the arm on the spot, fearing for her life.

After she came too, Ms. Rimo realised immediately what must have happened, but unfortunately it was too late, as her arm had, rather ironically, been sold on the black market to another Nazi memorabilia collector. She eventually recieved over 6 million yen (she insisted on the figure, despite being offered higher and the fact that this amount is only worth around $50,000) and rebuilt her home in accordance with her beliefs using forced labour. The court initially objected to the payment on the basis that she would only have used the arm to continue making Nazi salutes, but her attorney successfully argued that it was also possible that she wanted to make the peace/victory V symbol in selfies like many other asian women.

Ms. Rino, having spent her settlement money on some fur shaved from the tail of hitler's favorite cat, settled down once more to a quiet life of praying to her Fuhrer for the final victory and domination over the lesser races. "I tried to do it just like before" she remembers, "but it just wasn't the same. Without the ability to salute my Fuhrer properly first thing in the morning, I feel incomplete. I'm a failure as an Asian to Aryan trans-racial woman."

Hearing of Ms. Rimo's plight, he immediately contacted her and asked her to take part in her experiments.

Progress did not come easily, but after accidentally implanting a self aware tentacle beast at the base of her spine, he eventually located the stump of her arm with the aid of her screams and frantic gestures. Through what other, actual, doctors have called "an absolute miracle of beginner's luck" Ms. Rimo was in posession of a fully functioning Robotic arm. Speaking after the experience of giving her first Sieg Heil in such a long time, Mrs. Rimo commented that "I feel truly alive again. Truly the time has come for the old gods to return."

Eplilogue: Despite all medical advice to the contrary, Ms. Rimo has elected to remain working with Dr Aientistu in the hope of bringing about the final fall of mankind.
